description: This PHP source file defines an administrative controller class 'UsersSubController' within the Goteo project, responsible for managing user-related operations such as listing, editing, adding, moving, impersonating, and managing user roles and properties. It includes methods for permission checks, handling user move and impersonation actions, user management (add, edit, list), and role assignments.

classes.name: Goteo\Controller\Admin\UsersSubController
classes.description: Controller class handling admin user management functions including listing, editing, adding, moving, impersonating, role management, and property updates for users within the Goteo platform.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to access or modify resources at a specific node, requiring master node status or specific roles.

methods.name: moveAction
methods.description: Handles moving a user to another node, with permission checks, database update, event logging, and redirecting.

methods.name: impersonateAction
methods.description: Allows an admin to impersonate another user, with permission validation, session handling, logging, and redirect.

methods.name: manageAction
methods.description: Manages user roles, properties, and status (ban/unban, show/hide, language translation), with logging and redirection.

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Provides functionality to edit user details such as email and password, with logging and user feedback.

methods.name: addAction
methods.description: Enables creating a new user with submitted data, handling success and error states.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Lists users with filtering, sorting, and pagination options, including related data like roles and projects.
